Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Thanks for making time, Tom. Before I walk you through anything, tell me about Harbor Plumbing.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Sure. We're a one-shop plumbing company in South Austin, been at it since 2011. Nine guys on the trucks, my wife Maria runs the office and the books.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: What kind of work keeps the trucks busiest?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Water heaters, honestly. Repairs and replacements are about forty percent of our revenue. Then drain cleaning, and the emergency calls at night and on weekends.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: We do sewer line repair too, and I want to push tankless water heater installs harder because the margin is better.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Where are the jobs coming from geographically?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Most of them are Austin. We'd love more work out of Round Rock and Cedar Park, we drive through there all the time and the phone never rings from there.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: We get the odd job in Georgetown and Pflugerville as well.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Tell me about the website.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: A guy built it on WordPress back in 2019. It's slow on my phone, and when I search our services on my phone we don't show up unless you type our name.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: We don't show up in Round Rock at all. Bluebonnet Plumbing shows up everywhere we don't.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Are you running any paid advertising right now?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: We spend about $1,200 a month on Google Ads through a guy named Rick, but I couldn't tell you what we get for it.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: We tried Facebook ads once a couple of years back, nothing came of it, so we stopped.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: How are your reviews?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Reviews are the one thing we're proud of. We're at 4.8 on Google with a hundred and forty-some reviews. Yelp we don't really bother with.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Do you have analytics on the site, anything tracking calls or forms?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Rick put some Google tracking code on there for the ads, I think. I've never looked at a report.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: What would success look like six months from now?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Two more trucks busy in Round Rock and Cedar Park, and more tankless installs. If we could add fifteen or twenty jobs a month that would do it.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: And if the plan makes sense, what kind of monthly investment is realistic?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Honestly, $2,500 a month is about our ceiling right now, including whatever we keep spending on ads.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: I'll be straight with you. We got burned by an agency two years ago that locked us in for a year and sent us a PDF once a month. I'm not signing a long contract again.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Understood. Who else needs to be part of the decision?

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Maria. She'd need to sign off on anything over a couple thousand a month.

Speaker: Dwayne (WISE)
Text: Great. I'll put together our digital audit on harborplumbing.com and walk you both through it next week.

Speaker: Tom Harbor
Text: Sounds good. Just don't make it a forty-page PDF.
